error: lattice_dimension=2048 is below Distribicom's minimum of 4096 and will hang, not just run slowly: SEAL's coefficient-modulus chain at this size doesn't support keyswitching, so Galois key generation fails silently inside a worker thread and the round never completes. Use lattice_dimension >= 4096 (4096 is the minimum that works; 8192 is safer).

notes: Distribicom stores the DB as a db_rows x db_cols matrix of SEAL/BGV plaintexts; each plaintext packs elements_per_ptxt = floor(N / ceil(8*record_bytes/logt)) records. For this run elements_per_ptxt=19, so num_records=16384 is realised as a 30x30 plaintext matrix holding 17100 records (rounded up to a full square matrix).
polynomial_degree (SEAL ring degree N) = crypto.lattice_dimension = 2048; it must be a power of two supported by SEAL (1024/2048/4096/8192/16384/32768).
logarithm_plaintext_coefficient is fixed at 20 (not exposed by the generic config).
